brief.question: When does ANN-to-SNN conversion of a trained graph network preserve its accuracy, and what latency/step decisions can a practitioner make from the trained weights alone?
brief.answer: Within a configuration, conversion error is an exact identity governed by spectral gain and quantisation mass, giving validated laws and an order-invariant readout; across graphs, weight-only latency decisions do not transfer (three routes fail with measured mechanisms), while a validation-searched per-layer window allocation preserves accuracy with 22.7-93.4% fewer layer-updates in the deep regime (L=4).
brief.audience: Neuromorphic / graph-learning researchers and practitioners deploying converted spiking GNNs.
brief.domain_bridge: The graph aggregation operator turns conversion error into an exactly characterisable object (identity), which the paper then uses to explain when latency can and cannot be reduced.
priorities: deep-regime allocation capability with prior-art attribution

terminology.G_l: downstream gain product of layer l
terminology.layer-updates: total simulated per-layer timesteps incl. output
terminology.band: within 1.5 pp of the staged-uniform comparator at T*
terminology.deep regime: L=4 (3 hidden layers), where uniform T* explodes

facts.statement: The per-layer conversion error satisfies the exact identity B_hat_l - B_l = (1-alpha) A_hat (E_{l-1} M_l); the staged realisation gives max residual 0.0 (prior-run register ~2e-6).
facts.condition: as specified in the named artifact

facts.statement: Error amplifies as G^0.95 (r=0.990) with depth; a four-layer model loses about 21 pp at T=8, reported as a boundary result.
facts.condition: as specified in the named artifact

facts.statement: Layer-1 quantisation error scales with sqrt(H): width is the lever depth is not.
facts.condition: as specified in the named artifact

facts.statement: The margin criterion is 30/30 sound and 3.2-6.7x conservative (bound/actual median over T in {4,8}).
facts.condition: as specified in the named artifact

facts.statement: Membrane readout is order-invariant (0.0 pp spread) while count readout spreads 0.39-1.61 pp in the same cells.
facts.condition: as specified in the named artifact

facts.statement: theta=1.0 lies within one seed s.d. of the accuracy plateau on all five scanned graphs including both completed heterophilic holdouts (chameleon optimum 0.75, 0.12 pp from theta=1; Squirrel plateau 0.75-1.25 with theta=1.0 inside one s.d.); the q999 adaptive control loses 22.9 pp on Squirrel.
facts.condition: as specified in the named artifact

facts.statement: Validation-searched per-layer windows (idea family LD-SNN; graph instantiation here) keep the band with 22.7-93.4% fewer total layer-updates than best uniform T* on 6/8 held-out L=4 cells (squirrel 4/4, chameleon 2/4); random-search falsifier passed; criterion inclusive at 20.0%.
facts.condition: as specified in the named artifact
facts.attribution: LD-SNN (ISLPED 2022) idea family; PASCAL 2025 / MT-SNN 2026 prior art

facts.statement: The capability is a deep-regime re-scope: the pre-registered mixed L in {3,4} pilot criterion was not met (37.5%); L=3 has no headroom (1/8 inclusive).
facts.condition: as specified in the named artifact

facts.statement: Weight-only sweep-free latency selection fails to transfer: in-distribution kappa=1.0 exact (shuffled-c falsifier passed); held-out band 1/3, kappa [1.2, 11.0, 2.5]; pre-registered failure signal fired.
facts.condition: as specified in the named artifact

facts.statement: Closed-form weight-derived allocation rules fail their frozen pilots (R1 floor degenerates to uniform-64; R2 certificate clips at the 64 cap); windows >= 4 hold the band at 8-29% saving on 3/8 pilot cells, windows < 4 lose 2-5.6 pp.
facts.condition: as specified in the named artifact

facts.statement: The gap predictor required-T transfers 2/12 (LOCO MAE 4.6 pp): a third failed cross-graph weight-only route.
facts.condition: as specified in the named artifact

facts.statement: Cost rankings are accounting-dependent: under the pre-declared event-driven SynOps the F-to-C linear-readout arm dominates at T<=4 on Cora and CiteSeer (WP2 failure criterion fires), while static-update accounting has conversion cheapest on 3/3; non-domination by direct-trained arms holds under all conventions.
facts.condition: as specified in the named artifact

facts.statement: The published-architecture arm hidden-width parameter was inert (single F-to-C layer); true-width re-implementations show a working knob (10.4 pp spread) under three cost accountings.
facts.condition: as specified in the named artifact

facts.statement: Every ablation delta is attributed to the grid-bias default series (printed -3.68 vs computed -3.69); the default row is not bit-identical to the closed-form beta* row (max gap 0.56 pp).
facts.condition: as specified in the named artifact

facts.statement: Conversion is never dominated by the direct-trained spiking arms at matched accuracy across the tested grid.
facts.condition: as specified in the named artifact

facts.statement: At matched accuracy conversion emits 17-83% more spikes than trained arms in some cells; no energy claims (static proxies and event counts only).
facts.condition: as specified in the named artifact

facts.statement: The closed form scores the two-layer conversion against the T-step simulation with one sparse matmul: mean absolute discrepancy 0.08 pp (max 0.40) over 105 cells; at L=3 it fails by 3.5 points (33% of cells off by more), a boundary of the closed form.
facts.condition: as specified in the named artifact

facts.statement: The predictor ranks candidate models almost perfectly but misses the level: Spearman rho=0.967 (LOCO), gap MAE 4.6 pp.
facts.condition: as specified in the named artifact

facts.statement: Multi-view averaging over threshold and initial potential does not beat the ANN; a nine-ANN model ensemble does (+1.21/+1.06/+1.11 pp over controls) - the gain belongs to model ensembling, not to re-sampling discretisation error.
facts.condition: as specified in the named artifact
